info.name: InSearch — Campus Lost & Found API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive automated API testing collection for the InSearch Campus Lost and Found Portal at Sai University.

Covers:
1. System Health & Multi-Student Authentication (Reporter & Claimant)
2. Items CRUD, Status Lifecycle & Image Endpoint
3. Campus Location Suggestions & Verification
4. Claims Submission, Filtering & Admin Review
5. Notifications & Read Status Management
6. Admin User Directory & Role Filtering
7. Security & Negative Scenarios (401, 403, 400, 404)
8. Safe Cleanup of Test Artifacts
